posts.title: Bronek Masojada’s 2026 Lord Mayor’s Show – Featuring A Dance Troop Led At Previous Iterations Of This Square Mile Event By Jailed Spy Peter Wai – Is A Flop
posts.description: It was supposed to be a day of pomp and spectacle but instead the 3 mile long parade to mark the installation of Bronek Masojada as the 698th Lord Mayor of the City of London was more of a damp squib. Masojada’s show came across as a pointless and very low grade duplication of British state events featuring the Mountbatten-Windsor clan. posts.title: Reactions To Martha Grekos’ Proposals For Reform Of The Office Of Lord Mayor & Abolition Of The Alders
posts.description: We set out in this piece reactions to the proposals made by Alder Martha Grekos for reform of the office of Lord Mayor and abolition of the Alders, including in an “informal” meeting of the City Council that was supposed to be secret but which you can read about here.
